title: Slovakian Creamy Curry Soup
description: A hearty and comforting soup made with Slovakian ingredients and a hint of curry. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat the ghee in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion, carrot, and celery, and sauté until the vegetables are tender.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the vegetable broth, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Add the Slovakian dumplings, and cook for 10-12 minutes or until they are cooked through.
Stir in the date honey, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
